html:
The Warluwarra were an Aboriginal Australian people of far western Queensland, on the map along the Georgina River country near the Northern Territory border.

Almost nothing is recorded about them. Their neighbours on the map are the Bularnu, Yalarrnga, Andegerebenha and Kalkadoon. Cattle stations spread along the Georgina from the late 1870s.
sum: The Warluwarra were an Aboriginal Australian people of far western Queensland, on the map along the Georgina River country near the Northern Territory border.
